method_notes: Lewisham community primary admission arrangements (criterion 5 'Distance to school', as printed in 'Applying to start primary school in September 2027' booklet p11-12 and the council's community admissions policy page): distance measured in a straight line using the Local Authority's computerised distance measuring system, from the address point of the child's permanent home (NLPG eastings/northings, usually within the property footprint) to a designated point within the school. Booklet p23 says 2026 distances were measured electronically in metres to a 'central point within the school premises' / 'a point in the school premises as determined by the Ordnance Survey'; the 2024 grid says 'a nodal point within the school premises'. Criteria order: looked-after children, exceptional medical/social need, siblings, children of staff, distance. Ties: same block of flats -> lowest door number; otherwise drawing lots (witnessed). Twins etc. admitted as excepted pupils. Stillness Infant: sibling criterion includes Stillness Junior. The council grid covers community schools only; academies, free schools and VA faith schools are their own admission authorities.

gaps: Council figures cover only the 39 community schools; all 28 own-admission-authority schools (VA faith, academies, free school) are recorded not_published (council says contact the school) and their distance methods were not checked (straight line assumed). 2025 and 2024 grids are no longer on lewisham.gov.uk (404) and were taken from Wayback Machine copies of the original council URLs. The 2024 grid gives a distance for every school, even those that were evidently not oversubscribed (e.g. Kender 14818.25 m, Marvels Lane 6778.74 m, Dalmain 6103.4 m), while 2025/2026 grids say 'All applicants/places offered' for such schools; several very large 2025 figures (Kender 13505.31 m, Myatt Garden 5455.98 m, Marvels Lane 6238.29 m, Launcelot 6066.85 m, Kelvin Grove 4200.65 m) are recorded as printed but probably reflect lower-preference allocations rather than a real cut-off. Kelvin Grove 2024 printed as '20.000' - recorded not_published. Oak Gardens = Lucas Vale renamed (2024/2025 rows under 'Lucas Vale'). PAN = 2026 grid PAN for community schools (Athelney, Deptford Park, Elfrida, Forster Park, Rangefield, Oak Gardens show lower PANs than in 2024/2025; Launcelot 60 in grid but 30 in booklet directory) and booklet directory PAN for others. Postcodes from GIAS (Oak Gardens GIAS SE8 4QB; booklet gives St Nicholas Street SE8 4QF). Stillness Junior excluded (Year 3 intake).
